blocks.text: Sodium oxygen mein sunehri peele shole se jal kar sodium oxide aur sodium peroxide ka safed thos mixture banata hai. Sodium ko hawa se reaction rokne ke liye mitti ke tel (kerosene oil) ke neeche rakha jata hai; khuli hawa mein yeh oxygen se zor se react kar ke peroxide banata hai, 2Na(s) + O2(g) se 2Na2O2(s). Khaas halaat mein, jaise mehdood oxygen ya zyada darja-hararat, sodium oxide banta hai: 4Na(s) + O2(g) se 2Na2O(s).
Magnesium oxygen mein shadeed safed shole se jal kar safed thos magnesium oxide deta hai: 2Mg(s) + O2(g) se 2MgO(s).

blocks.title: Magnesium ke flares
blocks.text: Magnesium ka powder shadeed safed shole se bohat tezi se jalta hai, jis ki wajah se yeh aatish-bazi aur S.O.S. flares mein istemal hota hai.

blocks.prompt: Sodium ko mitti ke tel ke neeche kyun rakha jata hai, aur oxygen se yeh kaun si do paidawar de sakta hai?
blocks.explanation: Sodium hawa ki oxygen se zor se react karta hai, to mitti ka tel hawa ko door rakhta hai. Wafir oxygen mein yeh sodium peroxide banata hai; mehdood oxygen ya zyada darja-hararat par sodium oxide.

items: Sodium sunehri peele shole se sodium peroxide tak jalta hai (2Na + O2 se 2Na2O2), ya mehdood oxygen mein sodium oxide (4Na + O2 se 2Na2O); use mitti ke tel ke neeche rakha jata hai.
Magnesium shadeed safed shole se magnesium oxide tak jalta hai (2Mg + O2 se 2MgO); shola aatish-bazi aur flares mein istemal hota hai.
